product_launches.description: String, developed by Pipedream, launched a new platform that enables users to build AI agents up to 10x faster using natural language prompts, simplifying automation for non-technical users and offering advanced customization for experts.

overview_description.description:
String is a cutting-edge SaaS / AIaaS / CPaaS platform that revolutionizes sales and marketing automation for businesses across the MENA region. Its core focus is simplifying the automation process of marketing, sales, and communication and how our AI engine AMSA will play a pivotal role.

At the heart of String, we are building AMSA (Adaptive Marketing and Sales Assistant), an advanced AI engine that takes automation to the next level. By seamlessly integrating with a range of data sources, such as customer websites, social media pages, and historical client records, AMSA continuously learns and evolves to provide intelligent suggestions, personalized automation flows, and data-driven insights.​
